تقتصدون (form VIII)
# تَقْتَصِدُونَ (taqtaṣidūna) /taq.ta.sˤi.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
# تُقْتَصَدُونَ (tuqtaṣadūna) /tuq.ta.sˤa.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
